focus: station-level queue progression: UFC / E.ON Drive Infrastructure Italy

operators.name: E.ON Drive Infrastructure Italy S.r.l.
operators.tariffChannel: first-party ad-hoc/contactless/QR-weblink; roaming eMSP explicitly separate

currentFirstPartyTariffSurface.promotionRule: NOT rankable network-wide because EDRI labels prices as 'From' and its FAQ states charging prices vary by location, charger type and payment method.

positiveEvidence: EDRI Italy publishes current first-party ad-hoc tariff classes and exact power thresholds on its Italian tariffs page.
EDRI FAQ states current ad-hoc price is shown on the charger screen or online and varies by location, charger type AC/DC and payment method.
EDRI explicitly separates direct-payment pricing from roaming: roaming/card providers set their own final price.
Direct payment is available without registration via contactless bank card or QR/weblink; Visa/Mastercard, Google Pay and Apple Pay are documented.
negativePaths: The published class prices are minima ('From'), not a deterministic national grid applicable to every IT*UFC EVSE.
Therefore 0.695/0.79 EUR/kWh cannot be transposed to an individual Italian station solely from connector power.
Roaming prices from E.ON Drive or third-party apps cannot be substituted for the direct CPO/ad-hoc price.
operators.decision: Keep UFC station-level/fail-closed until each IT*UFC EVSE can be mapped to the current first-party charger-screen or QR/weblink tariff. Preserve the official class minima only as discovery/corroboration metadata, not rankable prices.
operators.blockingCondition: deterministic IT*UFC station/EVSE -> EDRI direct-payment portal/screen tariff mapping

coherence.atlante: setAside-last and excluded from active count
coherence.doNotRepeat: Generic UFC network-wide tariff research is exhausted. Resume UFC only with a concrete IT*UFC EVSE and its first-party QR/weblink/payment-screen tariff payload, or a newly published deterministic Italy-wide rule.

history.change: UFC first-party tariff model formally classified: official AC/DC/HPC thresholds and minimum prices captured, but EDRI FAQ proves location/payment variation; no network-wide price promoted.
